name: Hitomi no Juunin
source:
The first day of summer--- Yuu Narumi meets a lone girl.
Her name is Rena Otori. A slightly gloomy but ordinary girl.

Except, only Yuu can see her.

A slapstick love comedy about a boy and ghost girl! 

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE102166.html]DLsite English[/url]]
